pages.text: The canal was frozen solid. People glided across the ice.
Pongi put on her skates. Her ankles kept bending inward.
"I'm going to go around once without falling." Pongi stepped onto the ice.
Dad spread his arms beside her. "You push yourself along like this."
Dad pushed off with one foot. Then he fell straight down.
Dad fell again. This time he landed on his back, not his bottom.
Pongi moved forward a little at a time. She was slow, but she didn't fall.
She had gone halfway around. Her feet were trembling.
At the very end, her feet slid out. Pongi landed on her bottom.
But she kept spinning around. Still sitting, she made it all the way around.
